## Academic Projects

::: publication
### Longitudinal Survey Study on Adolescent Development in Sri Lanka

**Collaborators**: [Prof. Nancy E. Hill](https://www.nancyehill.com/)  
**Description**: Building a novel longitudinal dataset on adolescent development in Sri Lanka, examining how parental expectations, gender norms, and cultural values shape educational and career decisions among adolescents in urban and rural contexts.  
**Status**: Data collection ongoing (2023–present)
:::

::: publication
### Cross-National Study on Adolescent Aspirations

**Collaborators**: Research teams from the U.S., China, and Vietnam  
**Description**: Cross-national comparative study examining how sociocultural context shapes adolescents' educational aspirations and career planning across different cultural settings.  
**Status**: In progress
:::
